about.intro: KACERTIFIEX (KFCS) is a Lagos-based financial consulting firm for Nigerian corporates, high-growth companies and international groups that expect partner-led advice—not delegated compliance.
about.story: Since 2011 we have advised clients through IFRS transitions, FIRS engagements, fundraising cycles and market entry. Our partners hold international qualifications and have led mandates across audit, tax and consulting in Nigeria's most regulated sectors.
about.mission: We help leaders see clearly, decide confidently and deliver results that boards, investors and regulators can trust.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: We document our advice, protect confidentiality and tell clients what they need to hear—not what is easy to sell.

values.title: Rigour
values.description: Technical depth is non-negotiable. Our work is built for board review, investor diligence and regulator scrutiny.

values.title: Impact
values.description: We measure success in outcomes: cash preserved, risk reduced, reporting upgraded and transactions closed.

focus: IFRS reporting and finance function design
SME scaling, governance and outsourced finance
Market entry, CAC setup and investor readiness
Executive education on tax, finance and strategy
